{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",

  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "NumStability.CertifiedRectangleRiemannSolution",
      "interpretation": "By D021 and D029, a solution function bundled with initial Riemann data and rectangle conservation.",
      "effect_on_target": "The existential solution already carries the conservation property subsequently asserted.",
      "source_match": "The source discusses solving the conservation law; this certification is supplied through the method hypothesis.",
      "status": "fail"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "NumStability.CertifiedRectangleRiemannSolution.solution",
      "interpretation": "Projects the bundled function of space, time, and component.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the function evaluated at time zero and tested for conservation.",
      "source_match": "Matches the roles of x, t, and the components of q on printed page 1.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "NumStability.HyperbolicRiemannProblem.mk",
      "interpretation": "Constructs a law-indexed problem from left and right real vector states.",
      "effect_on_target": "Constructs equal-state problems in the consistency conjunct.",
      "source_match": "The two state roles match equation (1.11); equal states are a harmless degenerate data case.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "NumStability.IsOneDimensionalCellAverage",
      "interpretation": "Requires positive interval length, interval integrability, and equality to the normalized integral.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes every existential cell average to the exact average of initialState.",
      "source_match": "Matches the definition of a cell average, but supplies no relationship between numerical approximations and a physical solution.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "NumStability.IsRectangleConservationLawSolution",
      "interpretation": "Requires spatial integrability at every real time, temporal flux integrability at every spatial point, and the rectangle balance for every real a, b, s, t.",
      "effect_on_target": "Imposes a global, all-real-time conservation interpretation through the solver certificate.",
      "source_match": "Equation (1.10) is an instantaneous interval balance. These pages do not specify this global rectangle formulation or its regularity requirements.",
      "status": "fail"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "NumStability.IsRiemannData",
      "interpretation": "Prescribes the left state for x < 0 and the right state for x > 0, leaving zero unrestricted.",
      "effect_on_target": "Specifies the initial data of each certified solution.",
      "source_match": "Exactly matches the strict half-lines of equation (1.11).",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "NumStability.OneDimensionalFiniteVolumeGrid",
      "interpretation": "By D024, integer-indexed positive-length cells with consecutive endpoints identified.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies cell geometry and already guarantees the asserted adjacency.",
      "source_match": "Represents neighboring one-dimensional cells, with an added bi-infinite indexing convention.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "NumStability.OneDimensionalFiniteVolumeGrid.cellLeft",
      "interpretation": "Projects the left-endpoint function.",
      "effect_on_target": "Sets the lower integration endpoint and cell boundary.",
      "source_match": "Matches the left endpoint of a one-dimensional cell.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "NumStability.OneDimensionalFiniteVolumeGrid.cellRight",
      "interpretation": "Projects the right-endpoint function.",
      "effect_on_target": "Sets the upper integration endpoint and adjacency boundary.",
      "source_match": "Matches the right endpoint of a one-dimensional cell.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "NumStability.OneDimensionalHyperbolicConservationLaw",
      "interpretation": "By D025, a globally differentiable real vector flux with a Jacobian that is real-diagonalizable at every state.",
      "effect_on_target": "Restricts the admitted laws to globally defined, globally hyperbolic fluxes.",
      "source_match": "Captures the Jacobian criterion, but the selected source does not impose an all-state admissible domain.",
      "status": "fail"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "NumStability.OneDimensionalHyperbolicConservationLaw.physicalFlux",
      "interpretation": "Projects the law's vector-valued flux function.",
      "effect_on_target": "Uses the same physical flux in conservation and constant-state consistency.",
      "source_match": "Matches f(q) in equations (1.8) and (1.10).",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "NumStability.RectangleRiemannInterfaceFluxMethod",
      "interpretation": "By D026, bundles a domain, certified solver, information extractor, flux map, and constant-state guarantees.",
      "effect_on_target": "Assumes the solver and consistency properties before asserting existence of the workflow's outputs.",
      "source_match": "Provides a conditional interface specification, not a derivation that Riemann information yields an adequate numerical flux.",
      "status": "fail"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "NumStability.RectangleRiemannInterfaceFluxMethod.constants_in_domain",
      "interpretation": "Every equal-state problem belongs to the method's domain.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the constant-state solver call well-typed.",
      "source_match": "A reasonable extra method requirement, but not an explicit assertion of the selected passage.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "NumStability.RectangleRiemannInterfaceFluxMethod.domain",
      "interpretation": "Projects an arbitrary predicate on law-indexed Riemann problems.",
      "effect_on_target": "hdomain restricts applicability to grids whose adjacent states satisfy that predicate.",
      "source_match": "The source workflow has no corresponding supplied predicate; this reduces applicability.",
      "status": "fail"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "NumStability.RectangleRiemannInterfaceFluxMethod.extractInformation",
      "interpretation": "Projects a function from certified solutions to an arbitrary information type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Defines information from the existential solved family.",
      "source_match": "Preserves the syntactic information-extraction stage, but imposes no usefulness requirement.",
      "status": "fail"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "NumStability.RectangleRiemannInterfaceFluxMethod.numericalFluxFromInformation",
      "interpretation": "Projects an information-to-vector function.",
      "effect_on_target": "Defines numericalFlux without requiring approximation of a physical interface flux for unequal states.",
      "source_match": "The source requires numerical fluxes that approximate correct fluxes; the function type alone does not express that role.",
      "status": "fail"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "NumStability.RectangleRiemannInterfaceFluxMethod.solve",
      "interpretation": "Projects the supplied certified solver on its domain.",
      "effect_on_target": "Can supply existential solutions, but the conclusion never equates solved i with this solver's output.",
      "source_match": "Existence of solutions is assumed through the method, and execution identity is not preserved in the conclusion.",
      "status": "fail"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "NumStability.adjacentCellRiemannProblem",
      "interpretation": "Forms a problem with left state Q(i−1) and right state Q(i).",
      "effect_on_target": "Links every local Riemann datum to the two neighboring averages.",
      "source_match": "Exactly preserves the state assignment following equation (1.11).",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "NumStability.finiteVolumeCellAverageOn",
      "interpretation": "Evaluates the normalized spatial integral on each grid cell.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines the exact averages used by hdomain and available as existential witnesses.",
      "source_match": "Matches the cell-average definition in section 1.2.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "NumStability.riemannFiniteVolumeUpdate",
      "interpretation": "Returns Q_i − (Δt/Δx_i)(F_{i+1}−F_i), componentwise.",
      "effect_on_target": "The final existential merely names this expression.",
      "source_match": "Its orientation and normalization fit conservation, but the selected pages do not state this formula or certify its output as an approximation.",
      "status": "fail"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "NumStability.CertifiedRectangleRiemannSolution.mk",
      "interpretation": "Bundles a function with a proof of initial data and rectangle conservation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Shows that conservation is part of the supplied solver's return type.",
      "source_match": "The asserted conservation conjunct is inherited from an input certificate, not established for source solutions generally.",
      "status": "fail"
    },
    {
      "id": "D022",
      "name": "NumStability.HyperbolicRiemannProblem",
      "interpretation": "By D003, a pair of vector states indexed by a fixed law.",
      "effect_on_target": "Keeps the law associated with both initial states.",
      "source_match": "Matches a hyperbolic equation together with its two constant Riemann states.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D023",
      "name": "NumStability.OneDimensionalFiniteVolumeGrid.cellVolume",
      "interpretation": "The right endpoint minus the left endpoint.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the positive cell length in the update denominator.",
      "source_match": "Correct one-dimensional interpretation of cell volume.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D024",
      "name": "NumStability.OneDimensionalFiniteVolumeGrid.mk",
      "interpretation": "Requires positive lengths and right(i−1)=left(i) for all integers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Excludes zero-volume cells and supplies adjacency; does not require coverage of a specified domain.",
      "source_match": "Supports the local neighboring-cell geometry; a complete domain partition is not represented.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D025",
      "name": "NumStability.OneDimensionalHyperbolicConservationLaw.mk",
      "interpretation": "Requires a Fréchet derivative of the flux at every real vector state, its matrix representation, and a real eigenbasis at every state.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes global differentiability and hyperbolicity bundled hypotheses.",
      "source_match": "The matrix criterion matches printed page 3; unrestricted all-state validity is an additional applicability restriction.",
      "status": "fail"
    },
    {
      "id": "D026",
      "name": "NumStability.RectangleRiemannInterfaceFluxMethod.mk",
      "interpretation": "Requires a domain-restricted certified solver and arbitrary extraction and flux functions, with consistency only on the solver's equal-state outputs.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preloads the substantive solver and consistency claims while leaving unequal-state flux quality unconstrained.",
      "source_match": "Does not formalize the source's requirement that numerical fluxes approximate correct fluxes.",
      "status": "fail"
    },
    {
      "id": "D027",
      "name": "NumStability.oneDimensionalCellAverage",
      "interpretation": "Multiplies the oriented spatial integral by (right−left)⁻¹.",
      "effect_on_target": "Normalizes every exact cell average.",
      "source_match": "Exactly matches division by cell volume in section 1.2.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D028",
      "name": "NumStability.IsRealHyperbolicMatrix",
      "interpretation": "There exist real eigenvalues and a real basis whose vectors satisfy Av_p=λ_p v_p.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires complete real diagonalizability of every flux Jacobian.",
      "source_match": "Matches the real-eigenvalue and independent-eigenvector criterion on printed page 3; distinct eigenvalues are not required.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D029",
      "name": "NumStability.IsRectangleHyperbolicRiemannSolution",
      "interpretation": "Conjoins strict-half-line initial data and the all-real-time rectangle conservation predicate.",
      "effect_on_target": "Defines exactly what the solver certificate guarantees; adds no entropy, uniqueness, or similarity condition.",
      "source_match": "Initial data match, but the analytic solution interpretation is an additional specification absent from these pages.",
      "status": "fail"
    },
    {
      "id": "D030",
      "name": "NumStability.HyperbolicRiemannProblem.leftState",
      "interpretation": "Projects the first state.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the value required on the negative half-line.",
      "source_match": "Matches q_l.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D031",
      "name": "NumStability.HyperbolicRiemannProblem.rightState",
      "interpretation": "Projects the second state.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the value required on the positive half-line.",
      "source_match": "Matches q_r.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
